items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: Well, before Buck left New Orleans and went up north, he was playing with Jack Carey, he was, he played several times with Jack.

ctx.x: Who was he with, do you remember?
Well, before Buck left New Orleans and went up north, he was playing with Jack Carey, he was, he played several times with Jack. Mm-hmm.
Were there many guitar players around when you switched over to guitar?
